robocode.util

Class RobotFileAccess

  • java.lang.Object
    • robocode.util.RobotFileAccess

  • public final class RobotFileAccess
extends Object
    Used internally by Robocode for checking file access made by robots.

    When robot classes are loaded, calls to methods of File that modify files or read information about files are replaced with calls to the corresponding static methods of this class. These methods check that the robot is only modifying files in its own data directory, and only reading files in its own root package directory or data directory. Robots should not use this class directly.

    Author:
    Flemming N. Larsen (original)

    • Field Detail

      • in

        public static final InputStream in
        Replaces System.in for robots when their classes are loaded, so they never get the real one. Existing robots may have code using it, which must not prevent them from being loaded, and a robot is only stopped if it really tries to read from it.
